utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Alright, let's get started. Our goal today is to decide whether we can approve the revised Brightline contract, and to lock in owners for anything still open.

utterances.speaker: Morgan
utterances.text: Before we dive in, operations needs a go or no-go by end of week. Brightline's implementation team is only holding our slot through Friday.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Legal is mostly comfortable now. The revised indemnity clause raises the cap to twelve months of fees, which is what we asked for. The one thing I can't confirm yet is whether that cap covers third-party claims. I need outside counsel's read on the new language.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Okay. Someone should get the redlined indemnity language over to outside counsel today so that doesn't block us.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: I'll take that. I'll send the redline to outside counsel this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: On the finance side, the payment terms changed from net forty-five to net thirty. I want to be sure that timing still fits our third-quarter cash forecast before we sign.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: How quickly can you confirm that?

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: I'll rerun the payment schedule against the forecast and circulate the result soon.

utterances.speaker: Morgan
utterances.text: Separate topic. Brightline also floated a multi-year discount if we commit before the end of the quarter. Do we want to explore that now?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Not today. Let's put the multi-year option in the parking lot and stay on the revised terms.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: So here's where I think we are. I propose we approve the revised contract terms, contingent on outside counsel confirming the third-party coverage by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Dana
utterances.text: Agreed, as long as approval stays contingent on counsel's confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Agreed on my side too, assuming the payment timing checks out against the forecast.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Then that's our decision. Conditional approval, with counsel confirmation due Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Morgan
utterances.text: One more thing. Someone has to get back to Brightline with our final position before Friday, or we lose the implementation slot.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Right. We'll figure out who sends that after this call. Anything else before we wrap up?

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Okay, fair catch. Morgan, can you own the message to Brightline, out by Friday morning?

utterances.speaker: Morgan
utterances.text: Yes. I'll send Brightline our conditional approval by Friday morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: And put me down to finish the forecast check by Wednesday close of business.

utterances.speaker: Alex
utterances.text: Perfect. That closes it out. Thanks, everyone.
